items.title: ‘I have $400,000 in equity’: I’m 80. Should I sell my house because of dangerous stairs — or spend thousands renovating?
items.description: “Generally, the advice I’ve read says not to sell because I have a low-interest-rate mortgage.”

items.title: ‘I’m never selling’: I’m 47 and buy bitcoin with every dollar I earn. Am I crazy?
items.description: “When my paycheck lands, it takes a detour through bitcoin.”

items.title: I’m 77, pay rent and live off Social Security, but I help homeless people. Why are so many people going hungry?
items.description: “I am a retired senior citizen living check-to-check.”

items.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
items.description: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”

items.title: ‘I’d rather be on a beach in Bali’: My husband resents my $8 million net worth. Should I pay for his retirement?
Hollywood’s big debt deal hits a wall of higher yields as Paramount finances Warner Bros. buyout
items.description: The Paramount financing will be a closely watched barometer of dealmaking appetite despite rising borrowing costs in 2026.

items.title: Could SpaceX be worth $12 trillion one day? Citi says Starship gets it a step closer.
items.description: The recent Starship launch helps SpaceX with a number of priorities that could help its stock reach $900 over the long run, an analyst says.

items.title: The real prize in AMD’s $8 billion World Labs acquisition isn’t what you’d think
items.description: AMD is getting cutting-edge spatial-intelligence models, but more importantly, a leader who can help recruit top talent and bring real-world AI applications into focus.

items.title: Target’s price cuts are a sign of strength, some analysts say. Investors disagree.
items.description: A Jefferies analyst sees Target “prioritizing the health of the franchise over short-term profit optimization.”

items.title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
items.description: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”
